raw.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The Director, Partner Ecosystems – APAC, is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing a region‑wide partner ecosystem strategy that directly advances APAC sales and growth objectives.
You will lead, inspire, and develop a team of Partner Managers who build and scale a high‑impact ecosystem of VARs, VADs, Service Delivery Partners, System Integrators, and Technology Alliance Partners across a diverse and complex APAC landscape.
Reporting to the Vice President, Partner Ecosystems, you will serve as an executive‑level ambassador for BeyondTrust, cultivating strategic partnerships, driving partner performance, and modelling leadership excellence across the region.

What You’ll Do

Visionary Leadership & Team Empowerment

  • Provide clear, strategic direction to your team of Partner Managers, aligning them around APAC go‑to‑market priorities and a shared vision of partner‑driven growth.
  • Act as a coach and mentor, building leadership capability within the team and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance.
  • Guide your team in executing joint business plans and running effective monthly and quarterly business reviews that influence partner alignment and execution.

Strategic Ecosystem Stewardship

  • Architect and execute a bold APAC ecosystem plan that positions BeyondTrust and its partners for long‑term success, while adapting across varied regional markets.
  • Build and sustain executive‑level relationships with key partners, serving as a trusted advisor and strategic influencer at the highest levels.
  • Cultivate peer‑to‑peer, cross‑organizational relationships to strengthen collaboration, accelerate decision‑making, and broaden partnership impact.

Cross‑Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with sales, marketing, and enablement leaders to drive region‑wide alignment, ensuring partners have the resources, insights, and support needed to execute with excellence
  • Champion partner needs internally, influencing corporate strategy, enablement priorities, and resource allocation to support APAC goals.

Operational Excellence, Governance & Integrity

  • Ensure your team delivers comprehensive partner enablement, including ongoing sales, technical, and certification readiness programs
  • Uphold BeyondTrust’s rules of engagement by proactively managing channel conflict, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and promoting transparent communication.
  • Drive partner program adoption and enforce adherence to agreements, ensuring consistency, fairness, and compliance across the region.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of partner management experience in software security within APAC , demonstrating leadership impact across varied markets
  • Successfully built Ecosystems in Australia, India and Southeast Asia
  • 3+ years of experience leading and developing high‑performing partner management teams
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue objectives through influence, strategy, and partner execution
  • Deep understanding of APAC partner ecosystems and the ability to lead through cultural diversity
  • Demonstrated ability to build influential, lasting business relationships at senior and executive levels
  • Experience in strategic joint business planning and collaborative execution with partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • High‑energy, self‑directed leader who combines curiosity and a growth mindset with strong execution discipline.
  • Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to influence without authority.
  • Ability to interpret performance data to guide strategic decision‑making and coaching

Nice To Have

  • Experience building partner ecosystems in India.
  • Existing senior‑level relationships with current or potential BeyondTrust partners.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM, PRM systems, and reporting tools.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

raw.description:
About Proximity Foundation

Proximity Foundation runs structured coding education programs for young people aged 14-18 at Community Care Institutions (CCIs). Using a computer-based LMS curriculum covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL, we pair students with volunteer mentors in cohort-based sessions designed to build real technical skills and lasting confidence.

We are scaling from the first cohort to many cohorts within Mumbai and building the operational team that will carry this program forward. Every role in Proximity Foundation is a direct investment in the young people we serve.

Role Typ : Volunteer

Time Commitment : 2-3 hrs/week

Department : Partnerships & Growth

Reports to : Operations Manager

ROLE FOCUS

Owns the end-to-end partnership function — from identifying the right donor and CSR organizations to building and closing those relationships. Works hand-in-hand with the Comm & Outreach Lead to get the right materials produced, then takes those materials and executes the outreach and relationship-building work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct and oversee market research to identify and prioritize donor and CSR organizations
  • Develop and lead the outreach strategy for all institutional partnership targets
  • Build, manage, and grow a pipeline of donor and CSR relationships
  • Represent Proximity Foundation in partner conversations, meetings, and negotiations
  • Brief the Comm & Outreach Lead on what partnership materials are needed and when
  • Manage and support the Market Research and Partnership Outreach sub-roles
  • Report partnership pipeline progress and outcomes to the Operations Manager

WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK LOOKS LIKE

You'll be researching target organizations, sending outreach, following up on conversations, and briefing the Comms Lead on what you need. As the role grows, you'll manage two sub-roles who support research and outreach execution.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

You'll be building the financial and institutional foundations that allow Proximity Foundation to grow. This is a high-impact role with real strategic influence.

HOW TO APPLY

To express interest in this role, please send a short note (no formal CV required) to: Bhoomi.k@proximity.foundation

Tell us a little about yourself, why this role appeals to you, and any relevant experience. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds — enthusiasm and reliability matter most.

Requirements

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Stakeholder management | CSR / NGO landscape | Relationship building | Strategic outreach | Pipeline management

Only those candidates can apply who are:

  1. Driven by the social initiatives and want to make an impact in the lives of under-privileged students
  2. Can start volunteering from May 2026
  3. Available for duration of 4 months
  4. Have relevant skills and interests
  5. Women wanting to start/restart their career can also apply.

Benefits

BENEFITS

  • Certificate
  • Letter of recommendation
  • Flexible work hours
  • LinkedIn Recommendation

raw.description:
Our Mission:

Our mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Social Media Manager

Department

Communication & Content / Marketing

Reports To

VP, PR & Communication

About the Role

Social media at 6sense is about more than publishing content. It is about building a community of modern go-to-market leaders who want to learn, share what works, and continuously raise the bar.

The Social Media Manager is responsible for shaping and executing 6sense’s social presence as a place where marketers, sellers, and revenue teams come to discover new ideas, learn from industry peers, and see what winning teams are doing differently.

This role ensures all social media strategy, content, and community engagement reflects 6sense’s position as the leading platform for B2B pipeline generation and a trusted voice for the next generation of go-to-market leaders.

Equally important, this role helps activate and inspire internal advocacy across the company. By ensuring employees are aware of the company’s momentum, proud of the impact 6sense is making, and equipped with compelling stories to share, this role helps turn employees into authentic champions of the brand and its mission.

The role requires someone who is resourceful and works both collaboratively and independently, exercises strong business judgment, and combines creativity with deep analytical thinking. The ideal candidate is curious, experimental, and driven to build a meaningful and engaged audience.

This role reports to the VP of Creative & Communications and works closely with cross-functional partners across Marketing (and beyond) to bring integrated ideas to life.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Social Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and evolve the organic social media strategy to grow 6sense’s presence and influence among B2B marketing, sales, and revenue leaders
  • Identify emerging conversations, trends, and opportunities that position 6sense at the center of industry dialogue
  • Translate company priorities, research, product innovation, and customer stories into compelling social narratives

Content Development & Publishing

  • Lead the development and management of the social editorial calendar
  • Create and publish high-impact content that educates, challenges thinking, and inspires GTM teams to improve how they operate
  • Experiment with formats, storytelling techniques, and creative approaches that stand out in B2B feeds
  • Ensure social content consistently reinforces 6sense’s category leadership and thought leadership

Community Engagement

  • Foster meaningful conversations with practitioners, customers, partners, and industry influencers
  • Nurture and support a vibrant community where practitioners can share ideas and learn from one another

Employee Advocacy & Internal Engagement

  • Partner with internal teams to ensure employees are aware of and excited about key company announcements, milestones, and thought leadership
  • Create and promote opportunities for employees to amplify company news and insights through their own social networks
  • Help cultivate a culture of advocacy where employees feel proud to represent and support the 6sense brand
  • Provide guidance, inspiration, and resources that make it easy for employees to participate in social storytelling

Analytics & Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze social performance metrics to continuously improve reach, engagement, and audience growth
  • Translate analytics into actionable insights and new experiments
  • Identify what resonates most with the audience and evolve the strategy accordingly

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with PR, Events & ABX, Growth Marketing, Customer Marketing, Content Marketing, and Product Marketing to amplify campaigns, launches, research, and thought leadership
  • Bring social-first ideas into broader marketing and communications initiatives
  • Help turn key company moments into meaningful industry conversations

Performance Measurement

Success in this role will be measured through both audience growth and the depth of engagement within the community, including:

  • Growth of social audience among target GTM professionals
  • Engagement rates and quality of interactions across priority channels
  • Contribution of social media to brand awareness and pipeline
  • Performance of social content tied to campaigns, launches, and major initiatives
  • Adoption and participation in employee advocacy initiatives
  • Increase in employee engagement with and amplification of company social content
  • Development of new formats, approaches, and experiments that increase reach and impact
  • Ability to consistently surface insights and optimize strategy based on analytics

Qualifications

Educational and Experience Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience managing social media for a B2B technology company, media brand, or similar environment
  • Demonstrated success building engaged audiences and growing brand presence on social platforms
  • Strong understanding of LinkedIn and the broader B2B social ecosystem
  • Experience developing social content strategies that align with broader marketing and business goals
  • Strong writing, storytelling, and editorial instincts
  • Experience using social analytics tools to evaluate performance and guide strategy
  • Familiarity with marketing, sales, or go-to-market topics is highly valued

Competencies and Behaviors

Strategic Thinking

Understands how social media contributes to brand, influence, and business growth. Connects social strategy to broader marketing and company objectives.

Creativity & Differentiation

Brings fresh ideas and original thinking to content and storytelling. Constantly explores new formats and approaches to stand out in crowded feeds.

Curiosity & Growth Mindset

Deeply curious about what drives engagement and influence. Continuously experiments, learns, and adapts to evolving platforms and audience behaviors.

Analytical Rigor

Enjoys diving into performance data to uncover insights and identify opportunities to improve impact.

Ownership & Initiative

Resourceful with a sense for when to collaborate and when to advance work independently. Takes full ownership of strategy, execution, and results.

Community Mindset

Believes social media is fundamentally about people, relationships, and shared learning. Seeks to elevate conversations and help others improve how they work.

Advocacy Builder

Encourages and enables employees to share their perspectives, celebrate company momentum, and contribute to the broader industry conversation.

Base Salary Range: $89,411 to $137,097. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Our Benefits:

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

raw.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

What You'll Do:

As our Mid-Market Sales Executive, you’ll bring deep experience across the entire sales cycle and thrive in a high-growth, proactive, technology-driven environment. This role involves direct engagement with senior-level client stakeholders and requires the ability to drive transactions that spark urgency and position our solutions as a top priority within the organization. You’ll also play a key role in supporting our companies vision toward transformation to a high-impact, solution-based sales approach.
The ideal candidate is a proactive, trusted professional who builds credibility across client organizations. You will bring the business acumen and sophistication to present differentiated sales strategies while understanding what drives decision-making, including risks, opportunities, and priorities. Success in this role requires strategic thinking, the ability to develop strong business cases, and the skill to influence others effectively. You should be confident navigating complex sales conversations, building pipeline, and presenting high-level, value-driven solutions to executive audiences.

While the role is 100% remote, individual must be located in the United States.


Responsibilities:
  • Drive growth and profitability within assigned geography/vertical by consistently meeting or exceeding revenue, margin, and performance targets.
  • Effectively communicate and champion First Advantage’s vision, brand, and strategic value to prospective clients.
  • Identify, develop, and close new sales opportunities to maximize revenue and profitability.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders to enhance communication, retention, and long-term satisfaction.
  • Present and position a configurable, centralized solution that delivers clear ROI through efficiency, compliance, service excellence, and technology innovation.
  • Lead discovery conversations to uncover client needs, overcome objections, and present tailored, strategic business cases.
  • Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline, staying ahead of industry trends and client needs.
  • Provide feedback and insights to product and technology teams to influence innovation and ensure market-relevant solutions.
  • Leverage internal systems and cross-functional teams to optimize solution delivery, product configuration, and client service.
  • Stay current on industry benchmarks, trends, emerging technologies, privacy legislation, and the competitive landscape to inform strategy and ensure compliance.
  • Successfully navigate and close complex, consultative sales cycles with high-level stakeholders.
  • Provide ongoing post-go-live support to customers, ensuring a smooth transition, continued satisfaction, and long term partnership success.
  • Bring a collaborative, strategic mindset with strong critical thinking skills that enhance team credibility and contribute to First Advantage’s industry leadership.
  • Operate with agility and excellence in a fast-paced, dynamic, and performance-driven environment.

What You May Need to be Successful:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of consultative sales experience in a progressive, high-performing environment—ideally within human capital, BPO, or technology-based industries.
  • Proven ability to lead strategic discovery conversations, anticipate objections, and clearly articulate the value of a differentiated, high-impact solution
  • Consistent track record of creating urgency and priority within client organizations to drive momentum and close deals.
  • Strong experience negotiating and closing new business, including contracts, pricing, terms, conditions, and service level agreements.
  • Demonstrated success generating leads, building pipeline, and securing executive-level presentation opportunities through proactive, targeted outreach aligned with company goals.
  • Ability to access and influence VP and executive-level decision-makers across prospective client organizations.
  • Results-driven mindset with a history of meeting or exceeding monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas.
  • Skilled at accurately forecasting and managing a complex sales cycle involving multiple products and services.
  • Keeps a pulse on market trends, competitor activity, and broader industry shifts to inform sales strategy.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the agility to thrive in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment.
  • Willing and able to travel as needed to meet business objectives.

Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experiences, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:
  • Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
  • 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
  • Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!

The salary range for this position is approximately $60,000-$70,000 salary before bonus structure. This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

United States Equal Opportunity Employment:

First Advantage is proud to be a global leader in removing barriers and supporting our community members to ensure the changing demographics of the workforce are reflected in our hiring and employment practices. We value all of our candidates, employees, and clients, and place great emphasis on hiring and supporting qualified individuals in each role. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other area protected by applicable law.

Customer Engineer – Infrastructure – Azure Monitor -Bilingual (German and English)

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. Job Description:

The Azure Monitor Customer Engineer will work directly with customers, as a consultant and technical advisor to:

  • Design, Deploy, Review and Assess the health of the infrastructure
  • Upgrade and maintain deployments
  • Troubleshoot issues with infrastructure and agents
  • Tune and optimize for performance
  • Assist with reporting and visualizations
  • Implement new management packs
  • Assist in the development of custom management packs
  • Provide training in all areas of Azure Monitor to ensure customer goals are met

Ideal candidate experience:

15+ years working as a depth expert and technology owner or consultant for Azure monitor

Ability to present to multiple levels of customer leadership.

Ability to act as a consultant and architect for multiple customers.

Broad knowledge across multiple monitoring scenarios:

  • Windows and Linux Operating Systems
  • Azure Monitor
  • KQL Kusto Query language advanced level
  • URL, Network monitoring
  • Connecting to ITSM systems
  • Dashboards, Reporting, and Visualizations
  • PowerShell scripting

Deep level knowledge in at least 3 of the above categories

Broad knowledge of ALL the below areas, with deep understanding of (at least) 4 of the following:

Deep understanding of Azure Monitor architecture (metrics vs logs, data flow, ingestion, retention)

Strong knowledge of:

  • Log Analytics workspaces
  • Azure Monitor Metrics
  • Diagnostic settings
  • Resource‑level vs platform‑level telemetry

Ability to explain when to use Azure Monitor vs Azure Data Explorer / Grafana / third‑party tools.

Additionally, be able to ;

  • Write complex KQL queries across multiple tables
  • Use:
    • parse, extend, mv-expand
    • joins, time series, summarize patterns
    • performance‑optimized queries
  • Build:
    • reusable queries
    • functions
    • summary rules for cost & performance optimization
  • Debug slow or expensive queries

Tools

  • Visual Studio, Silect, MPViewer, Alert Update Connector, PowerShell

Linux OS and Linux Monitoring

Report Development

Network Monitoring

URL Monitoring

  • System Center Orchestrator
  • System Center Data Protection Manager

DEU Work-at-Home

Full time

raw.description:
JOB PURPOSE

The Solutions Engineer – Contract Logistics will play a pivotal role in designing winning, customer-
centric logistics solutions that strengthen DP World’s market leadership in integrated supply chain

services.

  • This role combines engineering precision, commercial acumen, and innovation to deliver
    operationally feasible, cost-effective, and sustainable solutions for new and existing customers

across the global DP World network.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Design & Business Winning

  • Lead the design of end-to-end warehouse and distribution solutions for customer RFQs, bids, and

renewals.

  • Translate customer requirements into optimized layouts, process flows, storage strategies, and

automation concepts.

  • Develop compelling solution narratives and data-backed value propositions that position DP World as the

logistics partner of choice.

  • Support business development teams with engineering models, costing, and technical content that enhance

our bid competitiveness and win rate.

  • Partner closely with Operations, Commercial, and IT to ensure designs are implementable, scalable, and

aligned with DP World standards

2. Engineering, Analytics & Optimization

  • Build detailed models to analyze order profiles, SKU velocity, throughput,
  • Create 3D and AutoCAD layouts illustrating optimal space design, MHE zoning, and picking strategies.
  • Assess automation and technology enablers (e.g., AMRs, AS/RS, robotic picking, conveyors) for business cases that drive long-term value.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to ensure designs deliver expected ROI and KPIs.

3. Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate across DP World’s network of engineering, automation, and operations teams to benchmark and replicate best practices.
  • Work with Finance and Procurement to define accurate cost-to-serve models, capex estimates, and supplier comparisons.
  • Represent the technical function in customer presentations, solution walkthroughs, and bid reviews to communicate DP World’s engineering credibility and value.
  • Support implementation handover to ensure smooth operational start-up and design integrity.

OTHER

  • Always act as an ambassador for DP World when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviours in
    harmony with DP World’s Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all
    activities; understanding and following DP World’s Code of Conduct and Ethics policies
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

JOB CONTEXT

The solution engineer is critical for growth and sustaining businesses

· Remote work- US

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial engineering, supply chain, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • 1-2 years of warehouse related Engineering experience in 3PL, solution design, warehouse
    engineering, or supply chain optimization.

· Strong expertise in:

MS Office Suite, Visio, AutoCAD/ Sketch Up/ Twin Motion or similar (layout and flow

design)

  • Exposure to warehouse operations/ Engineering within Tech, Consumer, FMCG, Retail market,

Ecom sectors.

· Most Certification

· Bilingual (Eng, Spanish)

Preferred:

  • Lean Six Sigma/ Green Belt certification is an advantage.

Ability to travel up to 25% of the time or as needed

SKILLS

· Exceptional Communication:

An active listener and articulate communicator — able to express complex ideas clearly in writing
and speech. Confident presenting to individuals or groups at all levels, with a tactful and professional approach when delivering facts or recommendations.

  • Analytical Problem Solver: Thrives on tackling complex challenges, identifying root causes, and developing creative, practical solutions. Remains composed under pressure and persistent in pursuing answers.
  • Detail-Oriented Precision: Maintains strong focus and attention to detail. Ensures accuracy and quality in every deliverable — believing that anything worth doing is worth doing right, every time.
  • Critical Thinker: Quickly identifies logical gaps and underlying causes. Learns rapidly, adapts easily, and applies sound judgment to make informed decisions in dynamic situations.
  • Collaborative and Self-Driven: Works effectively both independently and within diverse, multicultural teams. Highly organized, proactive, and collaborative, fostering a positive team environment.
  • Results-Oriented and Agile: Manages multiple priorities with discipline and a “can-do” attitude. Consistently meets deadlines and commitments, demonstrating initiative and accountability.
  • Professional Integrity and Confidentiality: Upholds the highest standards of discretion and data protection in all business dealings.

salary budgeted for this role: $80,000 - $90,000

Compensation

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

About DP World

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

Role Overview:

As the Global Compliance Officer, you'll be a key part of our legal and compliance team, responsible for ensuring the company operates in full accordance with all relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies. You'll play a crucial role in managing our compliance programme, with a particular focus on sanctions, fraud prevention and investigations. You'll also be responsible for developing and implementing Global compliance policies and delivering training to employees across the group. This role requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual with strong analytical and communication skills.
Remote: This role is fully remote to be based in the United Kingdom.
Hours: 9am to 5pm. The role is a permanent five (5) day a week role (Monday to Friday).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a compliance point of contact for teams across 20+ countries providing expert compliance advice, on topics included but not limited to conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, sanctions, risk management and regulatory changes.

  • Draft, review, and update internal compliance policies, procedures, and guidance documents. Ensure all policies are clear, comprehensive, and aligned with legal and regulatory requirements.

  • Support with the monitoring of applicable UK, EU, and US sanctions regulations. Manage the sanctions screening process and any necessary due diligence.

  • Conduct regular actionable reporting on compliance metrics to senior management.

  • Support with the company's ABC program, including risk assessments, third-party due diligence, and internal controls.

  • Develop and lead internal compliance audits as required.

  • Conduct fair, thorough, independent and evidence based investigations into potential compliance violations or allegations in line with applicable policies, laws and regulations.

  • Efficiently draft comprehensive, high-quality compliance investigation reports that clearly document findings, and actionable recommendations to improve processes.

  • Design and deliver compliance training sessions to employees at all levels, and across the global business.

  • Create engaging training materials and track employee completion.

  • Manage the intake, assessment, and resolution process for all internal compliance disclosures, ensuring confidentiality and timely action.

  • Partner closely and effectively with key stakeholders including Legal, HRBPs, ER, Privacy and Security teams.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in a compliance role within a multinational business.

  • Expertise: Strong, demonstrable experience in sanctions, anti-bribery, fraud, and internal investigations. Experience with policy writing and training delivery is essential.

  • Education: A degree in law, finance, or a related field. Professional compliance certifications (e.g., ICA, ACAMS) are highly desirable.

  • Skills: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. The ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Mindset: A proactive, resilient, and ethical approach to work. A keen eye for detail and a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of integrity.

  • Ownership & Process Management: Demonstrated ability to take full ownership of global compliance processes, driving continuous improvement and efficiency in compliance operations.

  • Culture & Ethics: Act as a role model, consistently demonstrating ethical behavior and integrity, and fostering a strong compliance culture across the organisation.

W.W. Grainger, Inc., is a leading broad line distributor with operations primarily in North America, Japan and the United Kingdom. Position Details

At Grainger, we are building systems to extend our market leadership for another 90 years. While lots of companies talk about "digital revolutions,” we're focusing on building the stuff that matters. Our expertise is born of an understanding of our customer and how our products and services create value for them. We are looking for product management talent to help chart a course for Grainger's enterprise systems and application development so that Grainger continues to be the destination for "the ones that get it done.”

The Senior Product Manager defines and evolves product strategy with a strong focus on maturing products, improving core capabilities, and strengthening the end-to-end customer experience. This role partners closely with engineering, design, and business functions to enhance, scale, and deliver products that meet customer and business needs. The Senior Product Manager thrives in a matrixed organization, converts business needs and complex technical capabilities into clear product direction and execution priorities, and drives continuous improvement across the product lifecycle. This person is highly customer-focused, business attuned and brings a track record of growing and refining successful products and services.

  • Lead products through the full lifecycle - from discovery and development through launch and iteration

  • Partner cross‑functionally with engineering, design, analytics, and operations to deliver high‑quality digital solutions

  • Use data and customer insights to inform decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure product success

  • Develop business cases and financial models to support product investments and prioritization

  • Influence stakeholders through clear communication, structured thinking, and evidence‑based recommendations

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, leverage emerging technologies, and enhance the customer experience

  • Experience contributing to or owning P&L, pricing strategy, or financial performance for a product or product line including customer requirements, product relationships, brand ladders, elasticity modeling, and marketing strategies.

  • Experience solving complex problems and translating ambiguity into actionable product direction

  • Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills, with experience working in matrixed organizations

  • Experience managing products or platforms across the full product lifecycle

  • Comfort using data, analytics, and financial insights to inform product decisions and outcomes

  • A continuous improvement mindset, with curiosity about emerging technologies and evolving customer needs

  • Superior process design skills and operational orientation.

  • Typically 7+ years of experience in product management or a related role delivering digital products or services

    • Experience may include strategic analysis, data‑driven decision making, and partnership with engineering and design teams

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a related field

    • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS) is a plus, but not required

raw.excerpt: About Caribou At Caribou, we care about giving people financial freedom so they can focus on what’s most important to them.
raw.description:
About Caribou

At Caribou, we care about giving people financial freedom so they can focus on what’s most important to them. Today, less than two percent of Americans refinance their auto loans despite drastic increases in the cost of new and used cars. We see huge potential to help folks reduce their monthly auto expenses, as well as increase the predictability of those expenses over time. We do this by building technology to pair customers with community banks and credit unions, and ushering them through the process quickly. On average, our drivers save $159/month on their car loans while protecting their investment long term.

Caribou is led by leaders from the technology, automotive, and finance industries. We’re proud to be backed by a great team of investors, including QED Investors, Goldman Sachs, Moderne Ventures, Accomplice, Link Ventures, Motley Fool Ventures and others.

About the Role

Caribou is looking for a proactive, organized, and articulate Customer Success Specialist to manage inbound customer communications, handle customer complaints, and assist with the pending Lender Approval process.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

Customer Support & Complaint Handling

  • Answer inbound customer calls from the customer call queue.
  • Provide professional, accurate, and efficient responses to customer inquiries, escalating issues as necessary
  • Maintain detailed notes of customer interactions in internal systems
  • Address loan payoff and insurance binder requests as needed
  • Appropriately escalate customer complaints received via inbound channels according to Caribou’s internal Complaints Process

Email Queue Management

  • Monitor and manage customer inquiries via the inbound email queue
  • Respond promptly and professionally to all emails, notating customer interactions in internal systems
  • Coordinate with internal team members who may already be assisting the customer to ensure consistency in communication.
  • Triage third-party emails and route them to the appropriate departments or personnel.

Pending Lender Approval Assistance

  • Support the Pending Lender Approvals and Lender Needs More Information process by reaching out to customers regarding lender requests.
  • Review customer-submitted documents to ensure they meet lender requirements.
  • Gather and verify any missing information on applications that could delay a decision.
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in email and phone correspondence with lenders

This role can be based out of our Caribou offices in Denver, CO or Phoenix, AZ, or remote/hybrid within the greater Denver, Phoenix areas.

About You

You, like us, are driven to achieve your goals. At Caribou, we have just three core values: Give a damn. Velocity. Make the assist. We’re motivated. We race towards our goals. And we help each other along the way.

  • Able to handle high-volume email and phone communications
  • Problem-solving mindset and a proactive approach to customer interactions
  • Strong sense of accountability and follow-through

How we will take care of you

Everyone at Caribou is a valued team member. Our compensation and benefits package includes:

  • Competitive compensation: $23.50/hr
  • Eligible for annual performance-based Incentive
  • Equity options
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Generous paid time off including Flexible Time Off (FTO) for all employees and 100% paid parental leave for all parents
  • Exceptional benefits including highly subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, and fully company-paid mental health, disability, and basic life insurance
  • Optional benefits to suit your individual circumstances such as HSAs (with Caribou HSA contributions), FSAs, supplemental life and health, legal, and pet insurance
  • Up to $1,000 per year for eligible professional development expenses
  • Employee referral program

Our Core Values

We come from all walks of life and are joined together by our shared values, which guide our work and how we work together.

  • Give a damn. What we’re doing matters. We show up determined to deliver results, and we love it.
  • Velocity. We’re intentional about where we’re going and we race towards it.
  • Make the assist. We have diverse strengths. We offer and ask for help so we all win.

Caribou is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, pregnancy status, marital status, military or protected veteran status, genetics, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position is not restricted solely to the responsibilities listed above, and the scope and responsibilities are subject to change. A pre-employment background check is required as a condition of employment.

We are looking for a Security Engineer to design, implement, and continuously improve security controls across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments. In this role, you will work closely with engineering, DevOps, architecture, and risk teams to strengthen security posture, reduce risk, and enable secure, scalable product delivery through automation and best‑practice security engineering.

🛠️ Your key responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across application, infrastructure, and cloud platforms using security engineering principles, automation, and enterprise standards.
  • Integrate security into development and DevOps workflows by implementing DevSecOps tooling, promoting secure coding practices, and ensuring security is embedded throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize security vulnerabilities, coordinating scanning, analysis, and remediation efforts with engineering and operations teams.
  • Monitor security events, investigate threats, and participate in incident response, applying detection, analysis, and containment procedures to minimize impact.
  • Act as a trusted security advisor by guiding architectural decisions, conducting threat modeling, and influencing secure design across teams.
  • Continuously enhance security maturity by developing automation, refining security standards, and contributing to documentation and security frameworks.

🎯 What we expect from you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience with security engineering across applications, infrastructure, cloud, and data environments.
  • Knowledge of SSDLC and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with cloud security architecture and controls (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong understanding of IAM, secrets management, and key management.
  • Experience with infrastructure and container security.
  • Background in vulnerability management and remediation workflows.
  • Experience with threat modeling and security risk assessments.
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, logging, and incident response processes.
  • Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, Terraform, or similar).
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders.
  • + Advanced English and availability to travel to São Carlos/SP when need it.

⭐ Nice to have

  • Security‑related certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS/GCP Security.
  • Experience developing internal security tools or automation.
  • Cloud‑native security engineering expertise.
  • Contributions to security programs, frameworks, or incident response improvements.

raw.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Claims AI Operations Lead will lead the transformation of our Claims operational model into an AI-native ecosystem. Reporting to the VP of Claims, you will design, implement, and continuously optimize a hybrid operating model that blends AI agents and human operators to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation across day-to-day claims operations.

Embedded directly within the Claims organization, you will serve as the bridge between operational reality and technological capability. You will work in close partnership with Technology teams to extend the impact of existing tools and identify new opportunities that require technical development or integration. You will ensure that AI systems and our claims talent work seamlessly together—delivering measurable outcomes and building a more adaptive, data-driven operating model.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Operational Transformation: Redefine claims workflows to leverage AI agents and automation, ensuring end-to-end processes are optimized for speed, accuracy, explainability, and scalability. You will partner with operational leaders to reimagine service delivery through AI-native design principles.

  • AI Agent Orchestration: Design, build, and oversee AI agents (task-specific and multi-agent systems), integrating them seamlessly into existing claims workflows.

  • Human–AI Collaboration: Define orchestration models and accountability frameworks for hybrid human–AI work. You will establish clear protocols for how AI systems and claims operators interact—including task assignment, escalation paths, and oversight protocols.

  • Monitoring & Governance: Implement monitoring frameworks to track AI agent performance, data quality, cost, and drift. You will collaborate with compliance and risk partners to ensure safe and responsible AI use within the highly regulated insurance environment.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure operational needs inform technology priorities. You will translate operational insights into actionable feedback for technology teams to extend and refine existing tools.

  • Training & Enablement: Build programs that elevate AI fluency across the Claims organization. You will equip frontline operators and managers with the skills and confidence to supervise and collaborate effectively with AI systems.

  • Innovation & Experimentation: Lead pilots and structured experiments to test new agentic patterns, workflows, or orchestration strategies.

  • Metrics & Outcomes: Define and track KPIs for human–AI collaboration, such as throughput, decision accuracy, automation coverage, and cost-to-serve.

Required skills and experience:

  • AI & Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of AI systems, automation platforms, and LLM-based agent orchestration frameworks with 1+ years of hands-on experience applying generative AI in real-world workflows, products, or operational use cases.

  • Data & Operational Insights: Proficiency with data, analytics, and business intelligence platforms (e.g.,Snowflake or Looker) to drive AI-driven decision-making and bridge the gap between business challenges and technical opportunities.

  • Operational Excellence: Background in technology, operations, or process re-engineering, ideally within a scaled service or technical environment. You are a strong systems thinker who can visualize the end-to-end claims lifecycle.

  • Change Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence across disciplines. You can champion a culture of confident and ethical AI adoption, helping frontline teams pivot to new ways of working.

  • Relationship Builder: Proven ability to build strong cross-functional relationships, prioritizing collaborative and empathetic communication with Product, Engineering, and Data teams.

  • Strategic Analytical Horsepower: Proven ability to leverage complex data sets to inform strategic initiatives, while articulating compelling, data-driven narratives that drive organizational vision.

  • Bachelor’s degree required, or equivalent work experience.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience in healthcare technology, insurance claims, or tech operations is strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Passion for experimentation, continuous learning, and building the next generation of AI-augmented operations.

Salary range: $140,000 - $200,000 /year (also eligible for cash bonus and stock options)

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Position Summary

Precision for Medicine is seeking a Project Manager, Marketing Operations to drive the execution, coordination, and delivery of key marketing programs. This role is essential in maintaining organized workflows, managing timelines, and supporting cross-functional communication. A major focus of this position will be managing projects related to our Autoimmune Programs, one of the organization’s key strategic initiatives.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented, execution-focused role ideal for someone who is proactive, highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and energized by bringing marketing projects from concept to completion.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Operations & Management

  • Support the planning, routing, documentation, and execution of multi-channel marketing campaigns, with an emphasis on autoimmune-related projects.
  • Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications to ensure campaigns deploy on schedule and align with strategic objectives.
  • Provide project management support for PFM conferences, virtual events, and brand-level initiatives (e.g., B2B newsletters, video development, thought leadership, PR activities, collateral updates, and social media campaigns).

Project & Resource Management

About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $450+ billion group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers to thousands of bus operators nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

About the Role

Title: Revenue Operations Associate

Reports to: Director of Revenue Operations

Location: Remote, US

We are searching for a Revenue Operations Associate who loves translating big picture strategic goals into actionable tooling, automation, and analysis outputs. This is an opportunity to shape a rapidly-scaling marketplace business that is leading the market across segments (consumer, mid-market, and enterprise). You’ll be a driving force behind ensuring our multi-segment Sales team can push the pace, looking each day to improve their efficiency and effectiveness, and to ensure management visibility into key metrics and trends. Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, this role is critical to helping us ensure alignment across our Sales segments, Finance, Marketing, and Partner and Service Operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with sales unit leaders and executive leadership to define, document, and manage the end-to-end revenue process, identifying bottlenecks and areas for optimization.
  • Design, implement, and document standardized processes for lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-close, and post-sales activities.
  • Analyze and assist in setting annual and quarterly revenue targets, forecasting, and compensation plan design. Provide regular forecasting support, working closely with sales leadership and finance to improve forecast accuracy and pipeline visibility.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis on pipeline health, sales productivity, campaign effectiveness, and customer churn/retention.
  • Serve as a second administrator for the CRM (e.g., Salesforce), including configuration, customization, data integrity, and security.
  • Contribute to the revenue stack tech roadmap, ensuring that we can stay nimble as we continue to scale.
  • Develop and maintain key performance indicator (KPI) dashboards and reporting across Sales and other revenue-related functions to provide actionable insights into revenue performance.

What You’ll Bring

  • A bachelor's degree, and 3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Enviable analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel/GSheets skills and advanced/intermediate experience with SQL. Tableau/Power BI is a plus.
  • Expert-level proficiency as a CRM Administrator (Salesforce required; certification is a plus), and demonstrated experience managing an integrated tech stack, including sales engagement (we use Outreach), marketing and process automation, AI, and other analytics products.
  • Superb communication and personal organization, with a knack for helping translate concepts and breaking down broad needs into actionable projects. You’re able to recommend solutions and then bring them to life.
  • Proven ability to propose solutions that balance speed and durability/scalability, and eagerness to steer projects to completion.
  • Familiarity with financial planning and analysis (FP&A) concepts related to revenue.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & Background Check
  • Welcome aboard!

$70,000—$90,000 USD

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, Miami, and Denver as we grow our global team.

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built-in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

AI Architect

Role Overview

As an AI Architect within the Transformation Office, you will serve as the technical engine for business change. You will design and execute an "intelligence layer" that operates across the enterprise, moving between high-level cloud posture strategy and low-level technical execution. Your focus is the rapid deployment of Agentic AI systems, LLM-powered applications, and Conversational Assistants that bridge the gap between legacy data and modern business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Execution: Design and deploy end-to-end architectures for Generative AI applications, LLM solutions, and Conversational Assistants that integrate seamlessly with business workflows.
  • Agentic System Development: Build and scale autonomous agents using AWS AgentCore and Azure AI Agent Service, enabling automated, multi-step reasoning and action cycles.
  • Cloud Strategy & Posture: Define and enforce the overall cloud posture for AI initiatives, ensuring high-level scalability and low-level security across AWS and Azure ecosystems.
  • Advanced RAG Design: Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to ground LLMs in proprietary enterprise data, optimizing for accuracy, retrieval speed, and context window management.
  • Legacy Connectivity: Implement non-invasive patterns to ingest data from legacy systems (Mainframes, SQL Server, on-prem DBs), feeding AI agents and assistants without requiring core system changes.
  • Advanced Analytics Integration: Partner with teams using platforms like Palantir, Databricks, or Snowflake to leverage unified data ontologies for enhanced AI reasoning.
  • IT & Security Partnership: Act as the primary technical envoy from the Transformation Office to the central IT and Security departments, ensuring all AI designs meet enterprise-grade governance, networking, and IAM standards.
  • Data Science Integration: Apply Data Science principles to the architectural lifecycle—overseeing feature engineering, statistical validation of model outputs, and the alignment of agentic logic with data-driven predictive signals.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field is required. A Master’s degree in AI, Machine Learning, or a quantitative discipline is highly desirable.
  • Experience: 8+ years in systems architecture, with at least 3 years specifically executing GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions in a complex corporate environment.
  • Agentic Mastery: Hands-on experience with AWS AgentCore and Azure AI Agent Service; deep familiarity with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).
  • Data Science Flavor: Strong ability to bridge the gap between Data Science and Architecture, ensuring that models are not just "plugged in" but statistically sound, validated for bias, and optimized for data quality.
  • Technical Stack: Mastery of Python, SQL, and PySpark; expert knowledge of vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, OpenSearch, or Azure AI Search).
  • Cloud & Platform Exposure: Proven track record in AWS and Azure. Functional exposure to advanced analytics platforms like Palantir Foundry/AIP is a major plus.
  • Transformation Mindset: Experience working in a Transformation Office or similar high-speed innovation hub, with a proven ability to partner with traditional IT to overcome infrastructure hurdles.
  • Execution Excellence: Demonstrated success in moving AI projects from high-level "Proof of Value" to low-level production-hardened systems.

raw.excerpt: About the Company:Based in San Diego, California, CovalentCreative is a technology and healthcare information company shaping the future of eyecare.
raw.description:
About the Company:

Based in San Diego, California, CovalentCreative is a technology and healthcare information company shaping the future of eyecare. Through leading brands like Eyes On Eyecare, Glance, and npiQ, we deliver innovative web applications, accredited education, and data-driven insights to tens of thousands of eyecare professionals. Our mission is to empower the people who care for vision with the tools, knowledge, and connections they need to excel.

Eyes On Eyecare®, the #1 provider of leading-edge clinical and career education for the next generation of optometrists and ophthalmologists, is seeking a detail-oriented and organized individual to join our team. Through an all-in-one digital platform, we provide editorial content, industry news, events, CE/CME, courses, clinical content, market research, and talent acquisition.

As our virtual events portfolio continues to grow—including large-scale summits, CE/CME-accredited programming, and sponsored webinars—we are seeking a Senior Events Manager to lead and scale our events operation.

Position Overview:

As Senior Events Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end production of our virtual events portfolio—from strategic planning and program development through execution and post-event reporting. You’ll be the operational backbone of every summit, webinar, CE/CME on-demand Course, and CE/CME event we produce, managing timelines that begin 6+ months before an event and extend weeks or months after.

This role sits at the intersection of project management, educational programming, and client-facing event delivery. You’ll coordinate across nearly every department—marketing, design, video production, client services, development, and operations—to ensure every event runs on time, on brand, and on budget. You’ll also manage an Events Coordinator and oversee independent contractors who support event execution.

Your job is to turn a date on the calendar into a polished, high-performing virtual event experience that delights attendees, satisfies sponsors, and builds the Eyes On Eyecare brand. If you thrive on complex project management, love the adrenaline of live production, and get satisfaction from building repeatable systems that scale, then this role will feel like home.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Oversight

  • Evaluate and evolve event production workflows — identify bottlenecks, redundancies, or manual steps across the event lifecycle and recommend process improvements that increase quality or reduce effort

  • Define and maintain production standards — establish consistent quality benchmarks for platform builds, livestream execution, speaker coordination, and post-event deliverables so the team isn't reinventing the wheel each cycle

  • Assess and recommend production tooling and vendor relationships — evaluate whether current platforms, contractors, and tech stack are serving the team well or whether alternatives would improve reliability, cost, or scalability

  • Drive post-mortem insights into structural changes — go beyond documenting what went wrong to actually redesigning processes, templates, or accountability structures based on patterns across events

Event Production & Project Management

  • Own the master timeline and process accountability chart for every event — tracking 200+ tasks across multiple teams from kickoff through post-mortem
  • Lead internal team kickoffs, pre-event meetings, all-hands, dry runs, and post-mortem debriefs
  • Manage event budgets in coordination with the operations team; track actuals against projections
  • Build and maintain all event pages and landing pages in our custom event builder platform (registration, schedule, speakers, exhibit hall, clinical track, conference bag, CE/CME hub, raffle, FAQ, and post-event pages)
  • Coordinate event platform setup, including navigation, footers, Stripe payment integration, magic link emails, pop-ups, and player notifications
  • Manage event-day operations: livestream coordination, real-time troubleshooting, attendee support, and HubSpot syncing
  • Oversee post-event landing page transitions, enduring content coordination, and event reporting

Educational Programming & CE/CME Coordination

  • Lead program chair relationships end-to-end: outreach, agreements, proposed agendas, meetings, moderator prep, and final instructions
  • Manage the full CE/CME workflow—speaker invitations, paperwork submissions, ARBO/COPE/VME approvals, pre/post-test coordination, and credit-claiming setup—in partnership with the Events Coordinator
  • Coordinate speaker selection, session format decisions (pre-recorded vs. live), speaker information collection, and tech check scheduling
  • Oversee the creation of moderator event notes, agendas, slide deck templates, and presentation instructions for program chairs
  • Manage polling question coordination across CE speakers, internal teams, and more

Speaker & Faculty Management

  • Own speaker coordination for all internal events—from initial selection through post-event publication hand-off
  • Manage speaker timelines, including credential collection, headshots, calendar holds, PIP (partners in promotion) asset distribution, and final reminders
  • Coordinate with the operations team on speaker contracts, payments, and program chair agreements
  • Manage sponsor speaker coordination in partnership with client services, including symposium scheduling and opening/closing remarks

Cross-Functional Coordination & Client Interface

  • Serve as the central hub connecting marketing, design, video production, client services, development, and operations for every event
  • Partner with the marketing team on event promotion: registration email workflows, LinkedIn event pages, email signature updates, PIP assets, and abandoned cart sequences
  • Coordinate with client services on sponsor deliverables: booth builds, banner ads, brand safety guidelines, courtesy reviews, and post-event enduring content
  • Work with the video/livestream team on pre-recordings, run of show, transition scenes, lower thirds, Streaming Software setup, and Zoom link management
  • Coordinate conference bag content, raffle prize management, and attendee engagement features
  • Provide creative and copy direction for event spec documents, registration landing pages, and event feature slides

Business Development & Strategy Support

  • Support event business development by creating exhibitor prospectuses, event feature decks, and commercial reels in partnership with sales leadership
  • Create and maintain the Source of Truth document for each event, building out the event run of show and tracking all sponsors, sessions, deliverables, and key dates
  • Contribute to event portfolio strategy: what events to run, reposition, or sunset based on audience data and sponsor-market realities
  • Build and refine repeatable event playbooks and process accountability frameworks that allow the team to scale

Team Leadership

  • Manage and develop Events Coordinators, providing day-to-day direction, feedback, and career development support
  • Oversee independent contractors supporting event execution (booth building, CE paperwork, reporting, platform setup)
  • Ensure clear task ownership and accountability across the events team and cross-functional partners

Who This Role Is Not For:

This role will not be a good fit if you…

  • Prefer high-level strategy without getting into the operational details — this role requires you to be in the weeds on timelines, platform builds, and day-of logistics
  • Struggle to manage complexity across many simultaneous workstreams and stakeholders
  • Are uncomfortable owning the full lifecycle of an event, from 6 months out through post-event wrap-up
  • Have difficulty holding cross-functional partners accountable to deadlines without direct authority
  • Find it stressful to be the calm, decisive point person on live event days when things don’t go as planned
  • Prefer working independently rather than constantly coordinating across marketing, design, video, client services, and development teams

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in digital/virtual event management
  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects with 100+ task timelines
  • Experience managing direct reports and/or contractors
  • Strong project management skills with experience in tools like ClickUp or similar platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a keen attention to detail
  • Experience coordinating across multiple departments (marketing, design, production, sales, operations) to deliver events on time and on budget
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Experience with CMS platforms for event page building and management
  • Proficiency with Zoom, Google Suite, Slack, and collaborative digital tools
  • Accept AI in department workflows and embrace LLMs for efficiencies

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in healthcare, eyecare, or medical education events
  • Familiarity with CE/CME accreditation processes (COPE, ARBO, VME) and continuing education workflows
  • Experience with virtual event platforms (Sanity, Cvent, Hopin, GoToWebinar, or similar)
  • Experience with HubSpot for registration management, email workflows, and attendee tracking
  • Experience managing program chairs, KOLs, or faculty for educational programming
  • Background in B2B or sponsored event environments where sponsor deliverables and client satisfaction are critical
  • Experience with event reporting, analytics, and using data to improve future events (LookerStudio, Parse.ly, or similar)
Salary: $65k - $80k

Are you a skilled QA & Verification Specialist ready for a challenging and rewarding next step? Do you combine strong technical expertise with sharp analytical thinking and a genuine passion for delivering high-quality software? If so, Codekeeper invites you to join our team.

We're looking for a detail-oriented professional with a talent for problem-solving and a commitment to excellence. In this role, you’ll help ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our systems while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Your work will directly contribute to maintaining the high standards our clients expect.

If you thrive in a dynamic environment that values creativity, teamwork, and continuous improvement, this opportunity is for you.

We’re accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications.

This role involves analyzing technical documentation, executing successful software builds in various programming languages, and validating software functionality against specified requirements. Additionally, you will be involved in conducting thorough testing of various scenarios, employing both manual and automated testing approaches. Your meticulous attention to detail will enable you to identify and report any bugs or glitches discovered during testing. Quality Assurance & Testing

Technical Analysis and Problem Solving

Collaboration and Communication

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Additional Backend, Frontend, and DevOps Tasks

As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

🌐 codekeeper.co
